output.summary: KEP-5732 adds topology-aware and DRA-aware workload scheduling to kube-scheduler, evaluating candidate "Placements" (node/DRA subsets) for whole PodGroups. Its current status is implementable, stage beta; during review the DRA-aware implementation was moved to beta, while topology constraints are the alpha-scope focus.
output.rationale: The problem is that the default pod-centric scheduler cannot resolve group-level topology constraints (e.g., co-locating a PodGroup in one rack), and external tools like Kueue or Volcano decouple that decision from the scheduler. The KEP proposes embedding Placement evaluation into the scheduler, reusing existing pod-level filter and score plugins. Reviewers narrowed the scope: the author moved DRA-aware implementation to beta to wait for KEP-5729 to define PodGroup-level ResourceClaims. The status was advanced from provisional to implementable on 2026-02-10 after a sig-scheduling maintainer asked for the change.

alternatives.option: Keep DRA constraints (DRAConstraints) in the alpha scope of this KEP
alternatives.why_not: Wojtek Szczesniak proposed removing DRAConstraints from scope and coupling it to the PodGroup/ResourceClaim lifecycle discussion in KEP-5729, and the author then moved DRA-aware implementation to beta.

alternatives.option: Use an external admission controller such as Kueue or an alternative scheduler such as Volcano
alternatives.why_not: The KEP argues that relying on external admission controllers decouples the topology decision from the scheduler's core logic, and alternative schedulers add operational complexity.

alternatives.option: Add a replicas field to PodGroup now and handle per-replica constraints
alternatives.why_not: Wojtek Szczesniak suggested not adding the replicas field yet and splitting all-replica from per-replica constraints, focusing alpha on the former; the sources do not record a final decision on this.

evidence.quote: Topology-aware scheduling is not a new concept and is currently addressed by external admission control systems like Kueue or alternative schedulers like Volcano.
I have decided to move the DRA-aware scheduling implementation to the beta of this feature and wait for the KEP-5729: DRA: ResourceClaim Support for Workloads to define required API
remove the "DRAConstraints" from the scope (and couple it the lifecycle of PodGroup/RC discussion we'll have in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/5729
We have `provisional` in the kep.yaml, so we need to make it `implementable`
